name: license-compatibility-analysis
description: Analyze open-source + third-party licenses in a codebase for compatibility with the intended distribution model. Inventories direct + transitive dependencies, classifies licenses (permissive / weak-copyleft / strong-copyleft / proprietary / unknown), detects incompatibilities (e.g., GPL in MIT-licensed SaaS, AGPL reach), notes NOTICE + attribution obligations, patent grant differences, commercial vs non-commercial restrictions, AI-model-weight license specifics, SBOM references. Produces evidence-backed findings. Not legal advice — engineering/compliance input for legal counsel.
